T: Occupancy factor of the space beyond the wall

B: Transmission the wall must have, P/(T D)
D: Weekly dose beyond the wall with no wall
P: Design goal for the area beyond the wall
R_t: Decay factor over the uptake time
T: Broad beam transmission through a shield of thickness x
alpha: Fit parameter of Archer's form, the slope of −ln T in a thick shield
d: Distance from the patient to the point beyond the wall
e: Euler's number, the base of natural logarithms
mu: Narrow beam linear attenuation coefficient at 511 keV
t_U: Uptake time, how long each patient stays in the room
